user.title: Pixoo64 Setup
user.description: Connect your Divoom Pixoo64 and link it to your primary media player.

data_description.pixoo_ip: Select your auto-discovered Pixoo64 or enter its local IP address.
data_description.media_player: The speaker, soundbar, or media player whose album art and track details will be displayed.
data_description.temperature_entity: Sensor to display live room or outdoor temperature on the screen overlay.
data_description.tv_mode: Shows a retro TV graphic with color bars when watching TV (HDMI-ARC, Netflix, YouTube) and turns room lights off. If disabled, the screen turns off completely or returns to your clock channel.

manual.title: Manual IP Entry
manual.description: Enter the local IP address of your Pixoo64 device.

data_description.pixoo_ip: The static or DHCP IP assigned to the Pixoo64 on your local network (e.g. 192.168.1.50).

lights.title: Ambient Lighting
lights.description: Synchronize your room lights and WLED strips with dominant album colors.

data_description.light_entity: One or more RGB lights that will dynamically match album art colors in real time.
data_description.wled_ip: Optional IP of a WLED controller to mirror album palettes and dynamic effects.
data_description.only_at_night: Only activate room lighting sync when the sun is below the horizon.

free_databases.title: Free Artwork Databases (No API Key Required)
free_databases.description: These community and public archives are queried automatically in the background without requiring any personal account or API key.

data_description.audiodb_enabled: Query [TheAudioDB](https://www.theaudiodb.com) for high-quality artist photos and discography album art. Recommended for Artist Gallery mode.
data_description.musicbrainz_enabled: Query the open [MusicBrainz](https://musicbrainz.org) database if cover art cannot be retrieved directly from your player.
data_description.internet_archive_enabled: Query the free [Internet Archive](https://archive.org) database for rare tracks, live concerts, and archival artwork.
data_description.prefetch_enabled: Pre-downloads and processes the next upcoming track's artwork into RAM before the current track finishes for seamless transitions.

apis.title: Streaming Services & AI API Keys
apis.description: Configure optional API credentials. A Pollinations AI Secret Key is strictly required to enable and generate custom AI album art.

data_description.spotify_client_id: Client ID from the [Spotify Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Required for 'Spotify Slider' mode.
data_description.tidal_client_id: Client ID from the [TIDAL Developer Platform](https://developer.tidal.com) for lossless cover matching.
data_description.tidal_client_secret: Client Secret from the [TIDAL Developer Platform](https://developer.tidal.com).
data_description.lastfm_key: API Key from [Last.fm Accounts](https://www.last.fm/api/account/create) for fallback artwork.
data_description.discogs_token: Personal token from [Discogs Developer Settings](https://www.discogs.com/settings/developers) for physical releases.
data_description.playlist_prefetch_range: Pre-fetches surrounding queue tracks (±5 or ±10 songs) into RAM. Requires active streaming keys.
data_description.pollinations_key: ⚠️ MANDATORY FOR AI ART: Obtain your secret API key from [Pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai). Strictly required for generating AI art. Leave blank if not using AI.
data_description.ai_model: Select the generative image model used when 'Force AI Art' is switched on.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Pixoo64. Please check the IP address and power.
error.spotify_id_required: Spotify Client Secret was provided without a Client ID.
error.spotify_secret_required: Spotify Client ID was provided without a Client Secret.
error.tidal_id_required: TIDAL Client Secret was provided without a Client ID.
error.tidal_secret_required: TIDAL Client ID was provided without a Client Secret.

init.title: Pixoo64 Settings
init.description: Configure playback tracking, ambient lighting, and external APIs.

media_section.name: Media Player & Screen Tracking
media_section.description: Configure the active speaker, temperature sensor, retro TV mode, and RAM pre-fetching.

data_description.media_player: The speaker, soundbar, or media player to track and display album art from.
data_description.temperature_entity: Sensor to display live room or outdoor temperature on the screen overlay.
data_description.tv_mode: When ON: Displays a retro TV graphic with color bars during video playback. When OFF: Turns screen off or reverts to clock.
data_description.prefetch_enabled: Pre-downloads and caches the next upcoming song in RAM before the current track finishes.

ambient_section.name: Ambient Lighting & WLED
ambient_section.description: Synchronize smart room lights and WLED addressable strips with live album colors.

data_description.light_entity: Home Assistant RGB lights that will dynamically match live album art colors.
data_description.wled_ip: Optional local IP of a WLED controller to mirror album palettes and dynamic effects.
data_description.only_at_night: Only activate room lighting sync when the sun is below the horizon.

free_databases_section.name: Free Artwork Databases (No API Required)
free_databases_section.description: Community-driven open archives queried automatically in the background without needing personal keys.

data_description.audiodb_enabled: Query [TheAudioDB](https://www.theaudiodb.com) for artist pictures and discographies. Free and requires no account.
data_description.musicbrainz_enabled: Query the open [MusicBrainz](https://musicbrainz.org) database for album art. Free and requires no account.
data_description.internet_archive_enabled: Query the free [Internet Archive](https://archive.org) for rare tracks and live concerts.

streaming_api_section.name: Streaming & External API Keys
streaming_api_section.description: Credentials for Spotify, TIDAL, Last.fm, and Discogs for animations and high-resolution art.

data_description.spotify_client_id: Client ID from the [Spotify Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Enables 'Spotify Slider' mode. Leave blank to remove.
data_description.spotify_client_secret: Client Secret from the [Spotify Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Leave blank to keep existing.
data_description.tidal_client_id: Client ID from the [TIDAL Developer Platform](https://developer.tidal.com) for lossless cover matching. Leave blank to remove.
data_description.tidal_client_secret: Client Secret from the [TIDAL Developer Platform](https://developer.tidal.com). Leave blank to keep existing.
data_description.lastfm_key: API Key from [Last.fm Accounts](https://www.last.fm/api/account/create) for fallback artwork. Leave blank to keep existing key, or type 'clear' to remove.
data_description.discogs_token: Personal token from [Discogs Developer Settings](https://www.discogs.com/settings/developers) for physical releases. Leave blank to keep existing token, or type 'clear' to remove.
data_description.playlist_prefetch_range: Pre-fetches surrounding queue tracks (±5 or ±10 songs) into RAM. Requires active streaming keys.

ai_section.name: Generative AI Art (Pollinations.ai)
ai_section.description: Configure conceptual pixel art generation. A Pollinations AI key is strictly required to enable this mode.

data_description.pollinations_key: Get your API key at [Pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai). Mandatory for AI art generation. Leave blank to keep existing, or type 'clear' to remove.
data_description.ai_model: Generative model used to create AI album art when 'Force AI Art' is switched on.
data_description.reload_ai_models: Switch ON and click Submit to re-fetch the latest models from the Pollinations API on the spot (without changing your key or closing settings).
